title: Поленница — Russian/Ukrainian Household Firewood Pile

sources.gost_3243_88: GOST 3243-88 «Дрова. Технические условия» — Soviet/Russian firewood standard defining length classes (I=1.0 m, II=0.75 m, III=0.50 m, IV=0.25 m) and maximum cross-section dimensions for household fuel wood
sources.forestry_handbook: Лесной справочник, Н.П.Анучин (1977) — practical forestry guide, standard поленница dimensions for fuel-wood stacking between end stakes (кольё); pile width 1.0–1.5 m, height 0.5–1.0 m
sources.tree_dims: Research brief 2026-06-10-nature-research-trees: Betula pendula DBH <0.40 m; Pinus sylvestris DBH 0.50–1.30 m — regional firewood species

log_length_mm.note: Class IV household firewood (дрова длиной 0.25 м), standard for wood-burning stoves (печи)

log_dia_mm.note: GOST max single-piece thickness ≤150 mm for class IV household дрова; 80–120 mm typical for unsplit rounds or halves of young birch/pine (DBH 10–20 cm)

pile_dimensions.note: Width 1140 mm = pile body between two stakes (within the 1.0–1.5 m standard range); height 650 mm ≈ 3 log-row bands (ergonomic waist-height stack); depth 260 mm ≈ log length 250 mm + 10 mm seating allowance for irregular ends

stake_dims.note: Кольё (end stake) driven into ground, protrudes 100–150 mm above pile top; section ≈ 80 mm round sapling or squared lumber

derivation.pile_body_half_depth_m: pile_dimensions.depth_mm / 2 / 1000 = 0.130 m (front/back face at z = ±0.130 from model origin)
derivation.cylinder_h_m: 0.020 m — end disc stands 10 mm proud of front face (embedded 10 mm, total thickness 20 mm, no z-fight: opposite normals at contact plane)
derivation.band_height_m: three equal body rows 0–0.54 m: 0.54 / 3 = 0.180 m each; residual lit cap = 0.650 – 0.540 = 0.110 m
derivation.stake_centre_x: (pile_body_w/2) + gap + (stake_sec/2) = 0.570 + 0.000 + 0.040 = 0.610 m (stake butts against pile side edge)
